inputs.name: frontends
inputs.description: Frontends, by name. Each listens on bind, such as "*:80" or "10.0.0.5:443", in mode http or tcp, and sends traffic to default_backend. tls_pem, a PEM file or directory on the host, turns TLS on.

inputs.name: backends
inputs.description: Backends, by name. servers maps each server's name to its address and port. check turns health checks on; check_path makes them HTTP requests for that path instead of a TCP connect.

inputs.name: timeouts
inputs.description: How long HAProxy waits to connect to a server, and for the client or server to send something before it closes the connection. Raise client and server for long-lived TCP connections, such as databases.

inputs.name: stats
inputs.description: HAProxy's stats page. null leaves it off; {} turns it on at http://127.0.0.1:8404/stats.

inputs.name: stats_password
inputs.description: Password for the stats page, with stats.user. When null, the page has no login, so keep it on 127.0.0.1.

inputs.name: selinux_connect_any
inputs.description: On hosts with SELinux on, turn on the haproxy_connect_any boolean, so HAProxy can listen on and connect to any port. Set false to keep the policy's port list and label ports yourself.
